checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: For supervised targets, relative-pose composition and 6D rotation reconstruction recover the demonstrated command FK pose; independent comparison uses world TCP position/rotation and gripper. Gram-Schmidt is the declared rotation projection and IK nonuniqueness is allowed.

contract.cut_relation: Every action in all twelve assigned [start,stop) slices is bound and supervised. This preserves the full blue relocation plus the substantial buffer_red predecessor and place_red successor overlap; only the Cartesian representation changes.
contract.output_semantics: Each prediction slot is [x,y,z,r6d_1..r6d_6,gripper], where position is metres and rotation is a 6D matrix-column encoding of a TCP pose relative to the blue pose observed at chunk construction. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; host execution uses slots 1..8. The reference pose is fixed for one chunk. decode_action projects 6D rotation by Gram-Schmidt, composes the relative pose with the chunk reference to obtain a world TCP target, invokes panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos, and appends the unmodified native gripper scalar.
contract.parameter_semantics: target_object selects the observed manipulated-object pose defining the chunk-start object frame; destination_goal selects the observed world goal point in metres; context_object selects buffered red for disambiguation and preservation context. Training binds blue, blue_goal and red.
